title: Spaghetti and Meat Sauce
steps: Place ground beef in a pan on the stove on medium heat
Add flour and redistribute (cook) ground beef until all excess liquids are absorbed
Add garlic and salt (just arbitrary amounts listed--do to taste) while allowing one side to brown.
Periodically “flip” and cook all the ground beef evenly When all is either browned or cooked all the way through, you’re finished
Keep ½ lb of ground beef on the stove and bring down temperature of pan to a simmer (lowest temp possible)
Add 1 can (standard small can size) of tomato paste, mixing together with the ground beef
Add 1 lb (standard container size) of Prego sauce and mix all together and simmer for a few minutes
